As a researcher and physicist, I tackle data analysis problems in gravitational wave astronomy using statistical and machine learning techniques.
I’ve worked with LIGO and LISA on problems such as detecting unexpected noise sources, quantifying statistical biases, and ML-based approaches to noise removal.
My contributions will help to facilitate proposed tests of general relativity and astrophysics, ensuring they can be performed with minimal compromise.

title: Amin Boumerdassi
text:
Field: gravitational wave data analysis.
Focus: extreme mass ratio inspirals from the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna.
Tools: machine learning and statistical techniques.
Past works: inference bias estimation, ML-based data cleaning.
